8-s28.condition: Round-up, Lesson 7, упр. 8, с. 28. Выбери лучший вариант морали рассказа «Кузнечик и Муравей».
steps: Лучший вариант — 4: always prepare for hard times in the future (всегда готовься к трудным временам).

9-s28.condition: Round-up, Lesson 7, упр. 9, с. 28. Прочитай рассказ вслух по ролям (Кузнечик, Муравей, автор).
steps: Кузнечик всё лето пел и танцевал, а Муравей работал и собирал еду на зиму. Кузнечик смеялся над ним. Зимой Кузнечику стало холодно и голодно, а у Муравья было и тепло, и еда. Читаем по ролям.
9-s28.answer: Читаем сказку по ролям: Grasshopper, Ant, author.

10-s28.condition: Round-up, Lesson 7, упр. 10, с. 28. Расскажи, где лучше жить — в городе или в деревне, и почему.
steps: I prefer to live in the town: there are cafes, parks, cinemas, a zoo and concerts.
Or: I prefer the country: there is fresh air, fruit and vegetables, I can ride a bike, play with friends and swim in the river.
10-s28.answer: town — cinemas, parks, zoo; country — fresh air, river, bike

11-s29.condition: Round-up, Lesson 7, упр. 11, с. 29. Расскажи, что люди делают на каникулах, где ты был и что делал прошлым летом.
steps: On holidays people walk in parks, go to the cinema, ride bikes, go to the seaside, go to the forest for mushrooms and flowers.
Last summer I visited my grandparents in the country. We swam in the river, went fishing and ate a lot of fruit and vegetables. I rode a bike every day.
11-s29.answer: People walk, travel, rest; last summer I visited … and …

12-s29.condition: Round-up, Lesson 7, упр. 12, с. 29. Задай вопросы к предложениям.
steps: 1. Did you go to the mountains last winter? When did you go to the mountains? Where did you go last winter? Who went to the mountains?
2. Was it your birthday yesterday? What was yesterday? Whose birthday was it?
3. Was your brother on holiday last autumn? Who was on holiday? When was he on holiday?
12-s29.answer: общий вопрос + специальные вопросы: when, where, who, whose

13-s29.condition: Round-up, Lesson 7, упр. 13, с. 29. Напиши три вещи, которые ты делал вчера, и три, которые не делал.
steps: I went for a walk with my friends yesterday. I visited my grandparents. I played computer games. I didn't swim in the river yesterday. I didn't dance. I didn't skate.
13-s29.answer: I went / visited / played…; I didn't swim / dance / skate…

1-s29.condition: Round-up, Lesson 8, упр. 1, с. 29. Соотнеси части предложений.
1-s29.answer: C, B, E, F, D, A

2-s30.condition: Round-up, Lesson 8, упр. 2, с. 30. Задай вопросы к расписанию (Future Simple).
steps: When will you leave the house? What will you do at 10 o'clock? Who will feed the birds? Who will you have lunch with? When will you go home? When will you go to bed?
2-s30.answer: When will you…? What will you do…? Who will…?

3-s30.condition: Round-up, Lesson 8, упр. 3, с. 30. Скажи, где и когда будет или не будет мальчик.
steps: He will be in New York in summer. He will be in India in winter. He will be in Scotland in July. He won't be in America in spring. He won't be in Canada in December. He won't be in Africa this year.
3-s30.answer: will be in New York / India / Scotland; won't be in America / Canada / Africa

4-s30.condition: Round-up, Lesson 8, упр. 4, с. 30. Расскажи другу о своей будущей поездке.
steps: On holidays I will go to Sochi. It is far from my city. We will go there by train. The weather will be warm and sunny, and I will swim in the sea.
4-s30.answer: I will go to … The weather will be … I will …

5-s30.condition: Round-up, Lesson 8, упр. 5, с. 30. Вспомни и спой песню о днях недели.
steps: Слова песни: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday; met, talked, smiled, laughed, danced, cried; fifth, seventh, July. Поём.

6-s31.condition: Round-up, Lesson 8, упр. 6, с. 31. Спой песню «This is the way».
steps: Слова: this is the way we wash our hands, comb our hair, clean our shoes, walk to school — on a cold and frosty morning. Поём.

7-s32.condition: Round-up, Lesson 8, упр. 7, с. 32. Прочитай текст о будущем и ответь на вопросы.
steps: Cities will be smaller and there will be farms in the cities. People will become taller and cleverer. Children will study in front of computers. People will go to the Moon and watch TV.
7-s32.answer: smaller cities; taller, cleverer people; study by computer; go to the Moon

8-s32.condition: Round-up, Lesson 8, упр. 8, с. 32. Расскажи, каким ты видишь будущее.
steps: In the future people will live in big modern cities with a lot of new technologies. They will work and study at home in front of computers. Robots will help them. At weekends people will travel all over the world.

9-s32.condition: Round-up, Lesson 8, упр. 9, с. 32. a) Расскажи, что вы с семьёй делаете каждый день; b) что вы будете делать завтра.
steps: a) We always brush our teeth and wake up at 7. I always have breakfast. My mother never has breakfast. My father sometimes cleans the house. My brother and I always go to school.
b) Tomorrow we will wake up at 7. I will have breakfast. My mother won't go shopping. My father will clean the house. My brother and I will go to school. I won't play computer games.
9-s32.answer: a) always / never / sometimes + Present Simple; b) will / won't

10-s34.condition: Round-up, Lesson 8, упр. 10, с. 34. Задай вопросы к ответам.
steps: Will you go to the swimming pool with me? What will they do? Why will you go there? What will he do? What will she buy for lunch?
10-s34.answer: Will you…? What will they / he / she…? Why will you…?

11-s34.condition: Round-up, Lesson 8, упр. 11, с. 34. Поставь предложения в отрицательную форму.
steps: You won't meet Max at 5. Next week she won't help you about the house. I shan't (won't) go shopping on Saturday. We shan't do our homework at night. He won't take a shower after dinner. You won't go to bed late.

1-s35.condition: Lesson 9, упр. 1, с. 35. Прослушай запись и повтори новые слова.
steps: Sunday — воскресенье, Monday — понедельник, Tuesday — вторник, Wednesday — среда, Thursday — четверг, Friday — пятница, Saturday — суббота; meet — met — встречать; laugh — laughed — смеяться.

2-s35.condition: Lesson 9, упр. 2, с. 35. Перечисли дни недели и ответь на вопросы.
steps: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday. Today is Wednesday. Yesterday was Tuesday. Tomorrow will be Thursday.
2-s35.answer: Monday … Sunday; today is …, yesterday was …, tomorrow will be …

3-s35.condition: Lesson 9, упр. 3, с. 35. Прочитай текст с новыми словами.
steps: We meet our friends on Sunday. I met Nick on Monday. We laughed a lot on Friday. Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday.
3-s35.answer: дни недели, meet — met, laugh — laughed

4-s36.condition: Lesson 9, упр. 4, с. 36. Скажи, какие дни идут после пятницы, воскресенья, среды и до субботы, четверга, понедельника.
steps: Saturday comes after Friday. Monday comes after Sunday. Thursday comes after Wednesday. Friday comes before Saturday. Wednesday comes before Thursday. Sunday comes before Monday.
4-s36.answer: Saturday, Monday, Thursday; Friday, Wednesday, Sunday

5-s36.condition: Lesson 9, упр. 5, с. 36. Соотнеси дни недели с сокращениями.
steps: Mon — Monday, Tues — Tuesday, Wed — Wednesday, Thur — Thursday, Fri — Friday, Sat — Saturday, Sun — Sunday.
5-s36.answer: Mon, Tues, Wed, Thur, Fri, Sat, Sun

6-s36.condition: Lesson 9, упр. 6, с. 36. Составь предложения по образцу (yesterday / today / tomorrow).
steps: Yesterday was Sunday, today is Monday, tomorrow will be Tuesday. Yesterday was Wednesday, today is Thursday, tomorrow will be Friday. Yesterday was Friday, today is Saturday, tomorrow will be Sunday. Yesterday was Thursday, today is Friday, tomorrow will be Saturday.
6-s36.answer: Yesterday was …, today is …, tomorrow will be …

look-read-remember-s36.condition: Lesson 9, с. 36. Прочитай и запомни правило: предлоги времени on / in / at.
steps: on — дни и даты: on Monday, on Thursday morning, on the 1st of September. in — части дня, времена года, годы, месяцы: in the morning, in summer, in 1997, in July. at — время: at 3 o'clock, at noon, at night.
look-read-remember-s36.answer: on — день, дата; in — месяц, год, сезон, утро / вечер; at — час, noon, night

7-s37.condition: Lesson 9, упр. 7, с. 37. Дополни предложения и соотнеси их с картинками.
steps: B — in the afternoon; A — at twelve o'clock; C — in winter; H — on Sunday; F — in 2001; D — on the 25th of July; G — in the evening; E — on the 1st of April.
7-s37.answer: in the afternoon, at twelve, in winter, on Sunday, in 2001, on 25 July, in the evening, on 1 April

8-s38.condition: Lesson 9, упр. 8, с. 38. Прочитай слова и угадай их значение.
steps: geography — география; kilometre — километр; history — история; historic — исторический; computer — компьютер; central — центральный; metre — метр; continent — континент.
8-s38.answer: geography, kilometre, history, historic, computer, central, metre, continent

9-s38.condition: Lesson 9, упр. 9, с. 38. Спой песню «We met on Sunday».
steps: Смысл: мы встретились в воскресенье 1 июля, разговаривали в понедельник, улыбались во вторник, смеялись в среду, танцевали в четверг, плакали в пятницу и расстались в субботу. Поём.
9-s38.answer: met, talked, smiled, laughed, danced, cried, parted — по дням недели

10-s38.condition: Lesson 9, упр. 10, с. 38. Прочитай дневники Мэри и Сьюзан и напиши, что они делают в каждый день.
steps: Mary: Tuesday — washing day, Wednesday — cooking day, Thursday — swimming day, Friday — tennis day, Saturday — shopping day, Sunday — visiting day.
Susan: Monday — reading day, Wednesday — swimming day, Friday — shopping day, Sunday — visiting day.
10-s38.answer: … is Mary's / Susan's washing / cooking / swimming / shopping / visiting day

11-s39.condition: Lesson 9, упр. 11, с. 39. a) Определи, из чьего дневника страница; b) посоветуй Сьюзан подарок брату.
steps: a) It's a page from Susan's diary.
b) She can buy him a book about animals or a football.
11-s39.answer: a) Susan's diary; b) a book about animals

12-s40.condition: Lesson 9, упр. 12, с. 40. Скажи, что Сьюзан делала в среду.
steps: Susan swam in the swimming pool on Wednesday.

13-s40.condition: Lesson 9, упр. 13, с. 40. Расскажи о себе: ведёшь ли дневник, есть ли у тебя дни покупок, готовки и т. д.
steps: I don't keep a diary. My shopping day is Saturday — I go shopping with my mum. My visiting day is Sunday — I visit my grandparents. I don't have a cooking day. I go to school from Monday to Friday; on Monday and Wednesday I play basketball.
13-s40.answer: I (don't) keep a diary. My shopping day is … My visiting day is …

14-s40.condition: Lesson 9, упр. 14, с. 40. Поговори с партнёром о том, что он обычно делает в каждый день недели.
steps: A: What do you usually do on Monday? B: I walk with my friends. A: And on Tuesday? B: On Tuesday and Thursday I go to gymnastics. A: On Wednesday? B: I play chess. A: On Friday? B: I go to the swimming pool. A: At the weekend? B: I visit my grandparents.
14-s40.answer: What do you usually do on …? — On … I usually …

15-s40.condition: Lesson 9, упр. 15, с. 40. Хорошо ли планировать каждый день недели? Почему?
steps: I think it's good to make plans for every day — you don't forget important things. But sometimes plans are broken: you can get ill or the weather can be bad.
15-s40.answer: Plans help, but they can be broken.

16-s40.condition: Lesson 9, упр. 16, с. 40. Напиши 7 предложений о своей неделе.
steps: On Monday I go to the sports club. On Tuesday I watch TV in the evening. On Wednesday I play football. On Thursday I go to the swimming pool. On Friday I read books. On Saturday I help my mum with the shopping. On Sunday I visit my grandparents.
16-s40.answer: On Monday I … On Tuesday I … (7 предложений)

17-s40.condition: Lesson 9, упр. 17, с. 40. Вставь предлоги и напиши предложения.
steps: In summer I lived in the country. But in September I came back to Moscow. I went to school on the 1st of September. It was Saturday. I didn't go to school on Sunday, but on Monday I was in class at 8.30 in the morning.
17-s40.answer: in, in, on, on, on, at, in

18-s40.condition: Lesson 9, упр. 18, с. 40. Научись писать дни недели.
steps: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday — с заглавной буквы.
18-s40.answer: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday

1-s41.condition: Lesson 10, упр. 1, с. 41. По картинкам скажи, что Ник делает в каждый день недели.
steps: Nick goes to school at nine o'clock on Tuesday. He has lunch at twelve on Wednesday. He goes shopping at three on Thursday. He watches TV at five on Friday. He plays football at one on Saturday. He reads a book at six on Sunday.
1-s41.answer: Nick goes to school / has lunch / goes shopping / watches TV / plays football / reads at … on …

2-s42.condition: Lesson 10, упр. 2, с. 42. Скажи, какой день у тебя день покупок, готовки и т. д.
steps: Saturday is my shopping day. Sunday is my cooking day. Wednesday is my swimming day. Friday is my visiting day.
2-s42.answer: … is my shopping / cooking / swimming / visiting day

3-s42.condition: Lesson 10, упр. 3, с. 42. Скажи, кого ты встречаешь, когда идёшь в школу, в магазин, в зоопарк, на стадион, в бассейн.
steps: I meet my friends when I go to school. I meet a shop assistant when I go shopping. I meet animals when I go to the zoo. I meet my friends at the sports ground. I meet my trainer at the swimming pool.
3-s42.answer: I meet my friends / a shop assistant / animals / my trainer when I go to …

4-s42.condition: Lesson 10, упр. 4, с. 42. Скажи, почему Алиса и Эндрю вчера много смеялись.
steps: Alice and Andrew laughed a lot because they saw funny monkeys at the zoo, watched a funny film, listened to funny stories and played funny games.
4-s42.answer: because they saw funny monkeys / a funny film / heard funny stories

5-s42.condition: Lesson 10, упр. 5, с. 42. Научись произносить и использовать новые слова.
steps: class — занятие: in class, after classes, before classes; comfortable — удобный: a comfortable chair, comfortable shoes; uniform — форма: a school uniform; P.E. — физкультура; Handicraft — труд; notebook — тетрадь; museum — музей; pencil — карандаш; see you later — увидимся.
5-s42.answer: class, comfortable, uniform, P.E., Handicraft, notebook, museum, pencil, see you later

6-s42.condition: Lesson 10, упр. 6, с. 42. Прослушай вопросы и ответь на них.
steps: 1. I usually have P.E. on Monday. Yes, I like P.E. We play volleyball, run and play games. We wear a sports uniform — a T-shirt, trousers and trainers. They are comfortable.
2. I have Handicraft on Thursday. We make things from paper and wood. I like it.
6-s42.answer: P.E. — on Monday, volleyball, sports uniform; Handicraft — on Thursday

7-s42.condition: Lesson 10, упр. 7, с. 42. Научись произносить и читать новые слова.
steps: When does the Russian class begin? Do you always speak English in class? After classes I often go shopping. Is your room comfortable? My new boots are comfortable. They all wear a dark blue uniform.
7-s42.answer: class, comfortable, uniform, P.E., Handicraft, notebook, museum

8-s43.condition: Lesson 10, упр. 8, с. 43. Составь предложения о том, что ты делаешь на занятиях, до и после них.
steps: I usually write and read in class. I never shout in class. I always chat with my friends before classes. I usually do my homework after classes.
8-s43.answer: in class — write, read; before classes — chat; after classes — homework

9-s43.condition: Lesson 10, упр. 9, с. 43. Прочитай слова и угадай их значение.
steps: programme — программа; champion — чемпион; problem — проблема; festival — фестиваль; tradition — традиция; paragraph — абзац; photo — фото.
9-s43.answer: programme, champion, problem, festival, tradition, paragraph, photo

look-read-remember-s43.condition: Lesson 10, с. 43. Прочитай и запомни правило: Shall I…? / Shall we…?
steps: Shall I…? — предложение помощи или вопрос «мне сделать?»: Shall I come back at 5? Shall I open the book? Shall we read the text? — «давайте?»
look-read-remember-s43.answer: Shall I…? — Мне…? Shall we…? — Давайте…?

10-s44.condition: Lesson 10, упр. 10, с. 44. По картинкам составь предложения с Shall I / we…?
steps: Shall I go to the shop? Shall I help you with your homework? Shall we go to the museum? Shall I cook something? Shall I wash the dishes?
10-s44.answer: Shall I go / help / cook / wash…? Shall we go…?

11-s44.condition: Lesson 10, упр. 11, с. 44. Прослушай, прочитай и выучи диалог, разыграй по ролям.
steps: George: What are you doing this Friday? Alan: I don't know yet. Why? George: We have a test on Saturday. Can you help me with English? Alan: Of course. When shall I come? George: Let's meet after classes. Alan: OK, at 2 o'clock. See you later. George: Bye and thanks a lot.
11-s44.answer: Can you help me with…? — Of course. When shall I come? — After classes.

12-s45.condition: Lesson 10, упр. 12, с. 45. Придумай и разыграй похожий диалог.
steps: Ira: Hi, Masha! What are you doing this Saturday? Masha: I'm going to the cinema after two. Why? Ira: We have a Maths test on Monday. Can you help me? Masha: Of course. When shall I come? Ira: Let's meet at my house at one. Masha: OK, see you later. Ira: Bye and thank you.
12-s45.answer: Диалог с просьбой о помощи: Can you help me…? When shall I come?

13-s45.condition: Lesson 10, упр. 13, с. 45. Прочитай письмо и скажи, о чём директор школы просит родителей.
steps: Marion Hayley asks everybody to be at school at 8, to wear a uniform and comfortable shoes, to take a raincoat, a packed lunch, a notebook and a pencil.
13-s45.answer: be at school at 8; uniform, comfortable shoes; raincoat, packed lunch, notebook, pencil

14-s46.condition: Lesson 10, упр. 14, с. 46. Прочитай утверждения и скажи, верны ли они.
steps: 1. False. 2. False. 3. False. 4. True. 5. True.

15-s46.condition: Lesson 10, упр. 15, с. 46. Скажи, что ты обычно делаешь в классе, до и после занятий.
steps: I usually read, write and listen to the teacher in class. Before classes I talk to my friends. After classes I go for a walk and do my homework.
15-s46.answer: in class — read, write; before — talk; after — walk, homework

16-s46.condition: Lesson 10, упр. 16, с. 46. Ответь: водят ли учителя ваш класс в музеи, когда ты был в музее, полезно ли это?
steps: Yes, our teachers take our class to museums. I was in a museum in summer. I liked it — it was interesting. I think it is useful to visit museums: we learn history there.
16-s46.answer: Yes; in summer; interesting; useful — we learn history

17-s46.condition: Lesson 10, упр. 17, с. 46. Выполни упр. 8 письменно.
steps: I usually write and read in class. I never shout in class. I listen to the teacher in class. I always chat with my friends before classes. I usually do my homework after classes.
17-s46.answer: in class — write, read, listen; before — chat; after — homework

18-s46.condition: Lesson 10, упр. 18, с. 46. Придумай предложения со словами class, comfortable, museum, uniform, P.E., Handicraft.
steps: We have a big class. This chair is comfortable. I like Handicraft and P.E. I liked the museum. We wear a school uniform.
18-s46.answer: Предложения с class, comfortable, museum, uniform, P.E., Handicraft

19-s46.condition: Lesson 10, упр. 19, с. 46. Выучи, как пишутся слова.
steps: in class, after / before classes, comfortable, uniform, P.E., Handicraft, notebook, museum, pencil, see you later.
19-s46.answer: class, comfortable, uniform, P.E., Handicraft, notebook, museum, pencil

1-s47.condition: Lesson 11, упр. 1, с. 47. Угадай загаданные слова.
steps: 1. Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday. 2. pencil. 3. uniform. 4. blackboard. 5. Saturday and Sunday. 6. P.E. 7. museum. 8. Handicraft.
1-s47.answer: days of the week, pencil, uniform, blackboard, weekend, P.E., museum, Handicraft

2-s47.condition: Lesson 11, упр. 2, с. 47. Заполни пропуски предлогами.
steps: 1. at; 2. in; 3. after; 4. on; 5. in; 6. before.
2-s47.answer: at, in, after, on, in, before

3-s47.condition: Lesson 11, упр. 3, с. 47. По картинкам предложи помощь (Shall I…?).
steps: Shall I close the window? Shall I carry your bags? Shall I open the door? Shall I wash the dishes? Shall I draw the picture?
3-s47.answer: Shall I close / carry / open / wash / draw…?

4-s48.condition: Lesson 11, упр. 4, с. 48. Ознакомься с новыми словами.
steps: half — половина: half an apple, half past four; past — после: half past two; desk — парта; classroom — класс; lesson — урок; never — никогда; timetable — расписание; Maths, Art, Music; study — studied — учиться.
4-s48.answer: half, past, desk, classroom, lesson, never, timetable, Maths, Art, Music, study

5-s48.condition: Lesson 11, упр. 5, с. 48. Расскажи о своём расписании.
steps: On Monday I've got six lessons: Russian, Maths, P.E., English, Music. On Tuesday — five: English, Russian, Handicraft, History, Literature. On Wednesday — Maths, Music, P.E., Art, English. On Thursday — History, English, Russian, P.E., Literature. On Friday — Maths, Russian, English, Nature Study.

6-s48.condition: Lesson 11, упр. 6, с. 48. Прочитай новые слова и предложения.
steps: Give me half a carrot, please. It's half past four. There are twelve desks in the classroom. What is there in your classroom? We never go to school on Sunday. Look at the timetable.
6-s48.answer: half, past, desk, classroom, lesson, never, timetable

7-s49.condition: Lesson 11, упр. 7, с. 49. Скажи, какое время на картинках (half past).
steps: It's half past six. It's half past eleven. It's half past two. It's half past three. It's half past eight. It's half past ten.
7-s49.answer: half past six / eleven / two / three / eight / ten

8-s49.condition: Lesson 11, упр. 8, с. 49. a) Скажи, что дети обычно делают; b) что они делают сейчас.
steps: a) He usually gets up at 7. They usually go to school at half past eight. They study at half past nine. They have lunch at half past twelve. They play football at half past two. He goes to bed at half past nine.

b) It's 7 o'clock — he is getting up. It's half past eight — they are going to school. It's ten — they are studying. It's half past twelve — they are having lunch. It's half past one — they are playing football. It's half past nine — he is going to bed.
8-s49.answer: a) Present Simple (usually); b) Present Continuous (now)

9-s50.condition: Lesson 11, упр. 9, с. 50. Прослушай и спой песню.
steps: Песня о днях недели: we met on Sunday, talked on Monday, smiled on Tuesday, laughed on Wednesday, danced on Thursday, cried on Friday, parted on Saturday. Поём.

10-s50.condition: Lesson 11, упр. 10, с. 50. Ответь на вопросы к песне.
